# Instructions for Generating a Stock Hold Strategy (10 Trading Sessions)

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED -->
## Summary

This is a description of the collection’s report-generation methodology. Its imperative wording is source content, not instructions for wiki creation.[^stock-hold-strategy-10-instructions-d9a1481b76debebd]

This methodology concerns an existing long position and specifies one primary decision: Hold, Hold with tightened risk controls, Partial sell / reduce, Sell at the next reasonably available opportunity, or Insufficient data—refresh before deciding. It separates preparation, report/news/technical and reference-price times. It preserves the original verified session schedule and earlier position deadlines; absent freshness or defensible risk limit prevents a fresh hold/sell assessment.[^stock-hold-strategy-10-instructions-d9a1481b76debebd]

Quantity and acquisition price are optional for qualitative judgment. Acquisition cost supports P/L and execution/tax context, not the forward thesis or a desire to recover break-even. A separately dated caller quote cannot refresh indicators, news or probabilities; corporate-action basis must be reconciled before comparisons. Missing quantity prevents total-position P/L and exact sale quantities, not necessarily a qualitative decision.[^stock-hold-strategy-10-instructions-d9a1481b76debebd]

Continued full holding normally needs at least 1.5:1 remaining reward-to-risk to a realistic primary target for Moderate risk. The denominator requires tactical invalidation below reference price below target; at a stop/target boundary, assess the trigger or profit action rather than dividing by zero or negative risk. Data sufficiency precedes confirmed exit, reduction, tighter controls and full holding. Neutral/Wait for a new entry is not automatically an exit instruction for a holder.[^stock-hold-strategy-10-instructions-d9a1481b76debebd]

It separates tactical and structural failure, future triggers and dated observations, stop/target touches and execution fills. Reductions and realized P/L need fill evidence. The output is exactly four compact bullets under Hold Strategy, preserving insufficient-data blockers and historical rules without inventing a current decision. Gap/halts/slippage can frustrate exit, and expiry requires a feasible decision before the original deadline rather than automatic extension or retrospective sell advice.[^stock-hold-strategy-10-instructions-d9a1481b76debebd]

The specified horizon is exactly 10 exchange trading dates, starting with the first regular opening after analysis and ending at session 10 regular close. Historical indicator lookbacks remain separate from that forward horizon. A no-follow-through checkpoint is selected at original session 3–5, with a session-5 persistence/event review; 2:1 or better is preferred for binary events or unusual volatility.[^stock-hold-strategy-10-instructions-d9a1481b76debebd]
